decisions.selected: Measure adoption of the issue-linked proposed experiment and required paired eval in the selected workflow.
decisions.rationale: The workflow creates an implementation issue that explicitly requires both an experiments block and a paired eval; creation and run volume are not operational attainment.

decisions.selected: One campaign issue and its target workflow.
decisions.rationale: The issue records the selected workflow and the concrete configuration to be adopted.

decisions.selected: Advisor run ID embedded in the campaign issue, with issue number, workflow, experiment ID, and eval ID parsed from that issue.
decisions.rationale: The durable run ID gives one deterministic historical reconstruction path when case and event are null.

decisions.selected: Target workflow source at the cutoff commit contains the campaign issue-linked experiment and paired eval.
decisions.rationale: Repository configuration is direct evidence that the proposed experiment was adopted.
This matches the workflow's campaign issue expiry and caps later observations at a stable cutoff.

decisions.selected: Binary 1 only for both the issue-linked experiment and paired eval; 0 for available evidence of either absent; null for unavailable evidence.
decisions.rationale: Both additions are explicitly required for the campaign and form one direct attainment target.
Before adoption there was no advisor-assigned campaign issue with the required durable run binding, so the same metric has no comparable pre-adoption subjects.

uncertainties.description: Historical runs before the durable Advisor run ID is present in campaign issues cannot be assigned.
uncertainties.mitigation: Return null assignment-unavailable; do not infer by issue timing or score zero.

uncertainties.description: An adopted configuration can be implemented by a human or another agent after the campaign issue.
